svg.title: On semaglutide, the quiet faded but people still ate less
svg.desc: STABLE trial, 120 adults, semaglutide 2.4 mg vs placebo, both with lifestyle counseling. How much better semaglutide scored than placebo on 0-100 point scales at weeks 20, 40 and 60: past-week hunger 17.5/10.8/6.8; food preoccupation 14.9/7.9/9.3; fasting appetite suppression 12.1/7.4/1. Only week 20 differences were statistically significant. Calories eaten at a buffet lunch, semaglutide minus placebo: 292/240/270 fewer, significant at every visit. Weight change: semaglutide -9.7, -14.6, -15.1%; placebo -4.7, -5.5, -3.4%.

svg.text: The quiet faded. Eating less didn’t.
